hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; { echo "# Stanje projekta (SessionStart hook)"; echo; echo "## Aktivni task — tasks/CURRENT.md"; cat tasks/CURRENT.md 2>/dev/null || echo "(nema aktivnog taska — pokreni /task load <NN>)"; echo; echo "## Git"; git status --short --branch 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo; git log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null; } | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:.}}'

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*|*"git push"*|*"git merge"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; br=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); hits_main=0; case "$cmd" in *":main"*|*" main"*) hits_main=1 ;; esac; [ "$br" = "main" ] && hits_main=1; [ "$hits_main" = "1" ] || exit 0; jq -nc '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"Ovo pise direktno u main. Konvencija repoa (.claude/docs/ai-interaction.md §4 i §6): svaki rad ide na svoju granu i kroz PR protiv main. Nastavi samo ako je korisnik izricito trazio direktan push."}}'
